ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the Cartesian coordinate system $xOy$, line $y=-2x+a$ intersects the $y$-axis at point $A$ and intersects the line $y=x+1$ at point $P(3, b)$. $B$ is a point on the line $y=x+1$. Find the values of $a$ and $b$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Substituting point P$(3, b)$ into the line equation $y=x+1$, we get: $b=4$. Substituting P$(3, 4)$ into $y=-2x+a$, we derive: $a=10$.\\
Hence, $a=\boxed{10}$ and $b=\boxed{4}$.
